name: Stick umbrella
summary: Sliding the runner up the shaft pushes thin struts outward that stretch the fabric into a dome, and it stays open until you press a small button on the shaft.

parts.name: Runner
parts.role: The ring you slide up the shaft to open the umbrella.

parts.name: Ribs and struts
parts.role: Thin arms hinged at the top of the shaft, pushed outward by struts from the runner.

parts.name: Canopy
parts.role: The fabric that keeps the rain off.
